housing.summary: No reliable source was found for an average city-centre one-bedroom rent in Swords. Daft lists current Swords rentals at https://www.daft.ie/property-for-rent/swords-dublin; the RTB states that a landlord cannot request a deposit above one month's rent at https://rtb.ie/compliance/what-can-the-rtb-investigate/.

banking.summary: Bank of Ireland's Coming to Ireland process accepts applications up to 45 days before a move and requires valid photo identification, proof of address and a selfie.
required_docs: valid photo identification: passport, driving licence card or EU national ID card
proof of address: an eligible utility bill, financial statement or specified official letter

schools.summary: The Department of Education's Find a school service is a map-based directory for locating schools by area. No opened source established an international curriculum in Swords.

legal_admin.summary: People from outside the EU, EEA, UK or Switzerland who intend to stay more than 90 days must register their permission with Immigration Service Delivery within 90 days of arrival and make a Registration Office appointment.
legal_admin.registration_step: Make an appointment and register immigration permission with Immigration Service Delivery within 90 days of arrival if staying more than 90 days and subject to the non-EU/EEA/UK/Swiss rule.

tax_finance.summary: Apply online for a PPS Number with a basic MyGovID account, give a valid reason such as starting a job to pay tax, and attend the required in-person appointment.

transport.summary: TFI Dublin's adult Zone 1 monthly ticket costs EUR 96 at https://www.transportforireland.ie/fares/new-fare-zones/. NDLS licence-exchange rules are at https://www.ndls.ie/licensed-driver/exchange-my-foreign-driving-licence. HSE medical-card and GP-visit-card applications are at https://www2.hse.ie/services/schemes-allowances/medical-cards/applying/apply/.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: An EU/EEA licence may be used while valid and may be exchanged; on taking up normal residence, holders of licences from recognised states must exchange or apply for an Irish licence, while licences from non-recognised states cannot be exchanged.
transport.healthcare_registration: Apply online to the HSE for a medical card or GP visit card; provide PPS numbers, dates of birth, and income and expense details for everyone included.
